name: Italian (BA)
totalCreditsNote: 120 cr per the 2026-27 catalog, at least 100 of them in Arts & Sciences and 80 letter-graded (the app doesn't check those two). Confirm with your advisor.
footnote: Eight courses are required, each with a letter grade of B- or better; S/U courses do not count. No more than three of the eight may be taken abroad or at an institution other than Cornell; verify this limit with your advisor. Honors is optional and adds thesis research and coursework beyond the major; eligibility requires a major GPA of at least 3.5 and evidence of independent research. Study abroad is encouraged, especially the Bologna Consortial Studies Program.

sections.title: Required Coursework
sections.note: Approved equivalent courses may replace each required course; the catalog does not list equivalents. ITAL 2203 is offered in Italian in fall; ITAL 2900 is offered in English in spring and has no prerequisites. Preparation: ITAL 1201, ITAL 1202, then ITAL 2201. After ITAL 2201, take eligible 2000-level courses taught in Italian; courses above ITAL 2201 need not be taken in numerical order.

sections.title: Italian Electives
sections.note: Five electives at the 2000 level or above, normally at least 3 credits each, focused on Italian literature or culture. Courses may be offered in Romance Studies or other departments, including History, Architecture, History of Art, Government, and Sociology; the catalog gives no definitive course list, so confirm eligibility with your advisor. At least one elective must focus on a period before 1800; no more than three electives may be taught in English. Taking as many as possible in Italian is strongly encouraged. If both ITAL 2900 and ITAL 2204 are taken, the second counts here. An ITAL course of 1.5 or 2 credits counts as half a course and must be paired with another 1.5- or 2-credit course; the rows cannot represent those pairs. Verify pairs, historical focus, and teaching language manually.

sections.title: Physical Education
sections.note: Two PE classes plus the swim test, a university requirement. PE credits do not count toward the 120.

checks.title: First-Year Writing Seminars
checks.missText: needs two FWS courses by the end of sophomore year. A 5 on AP English or a 7 on IB HL English covers one. FWS courses can't count toward anything else.

checks.title: Foreign Language
checks.missText: needs a FLOPI-AS course (a 2000+ course in or about a language), or 11 credits in one language at Cornell (Option 2). Native speakers may be exempt.
